summary: One-time initialization of thread-local storage for allocation tracking. Calls sub_58DFC1 to set up synchronization primitives, allocates a TLS index into global dwTlsIndex via TlsAlloc, allocates a 116-byte per-thread block via sub_58AB58(1, 116), stores it in the TLS slot via TlsSetValue, initializes the block via TwoFieldInitializer_e0b4, records GetCurrentThreadId() into the block's first field and -1 into the second, and returns 1. Any failure (TLS index -1, null block, or failed TlsSetValue) returns 0. Called by sub_58A19E (0x0058A19E).

operations.description: Call sub_58DFC1 to initialize the critical sections / synchronization primitives used by the allocation machinery.
Call TlsAlloc (Win32 import) and store the resulting TLS slot index into global dwTlsIndex.
Call sub_58AB58(1, 116) to allocate the 116-byte per-thread block (count 1, byte size 116).
Guard: if the allocated block is null, or TlsSetValue(dwTlsIndex, block) returns 0 (failure), return 0.
Call TwoFieldInitializer_e0b4 on the allocated block to initialize its two fields with default values.
Call GetCurrentThreadId (Win32 import) to obtain the current thread identifier.
Store -1 into the block's second field (v1[1]) as a sentinel.
Store the current thread ID into the block's first field (*v1).
Return 1 on success; 0 on any earlier failure.
Called by sub_58A19E (0x0058A19E) to bootstrap the TLS allocation-tracking state.

unresolved: Layout and purpose of the 116-byte per-thread block beyond its first two dword fields (thread ID and -1 sentinel).
Semantics of the -1 sentinel in the second field and who consumes it.
Identity of the owning allocation-tracking subsystem and the meaning of the other 108 bytes of the block.
